Name: Meshillemoth, Father of Berechiah
Summary: Meshillemoth was the father of Berechiah, a head of Ephraim who opposed keeping Judah's captives.
KeyStory: Meshillemoth is named only as the father of Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth.
LifeLesson: A father's name stands behind a son's stand for mercy.
